Theme

Latin word

agō

agō, agere, ēgī, āctum

verb, third conjugation

act, do, take action; act, play (a part); keep, celebrate (a feast day, a birthday); discuss, talk over (with someone); drive (a car, a truck, a bus); perform (a play), play (a part); spend, pass (time)

  • discuss

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 4.4.1: cētera cōram agēmus; Cic. Att. 3.9.2: sed tēcum haec omnia cōram agēmus; Traupman 97: cōram id agere possumus, we can discuss that face to face; Traupman 105: we can discuss that one on one, id cōram agere possumus

    also used · modern · Traupman 215, 216

Examples

  • advolā ad nōs eō animō ut nōs amēs, tē amārī sciās. cētera cōram agēmus.

    Hurry to us, ready to love us and sure that you are loved. We’ll discuss the rest in person.Cic. Att. 4.4.1

    In the entry for discuss

  • sīn es in viā, cum eris mē adsecūtus, cōram agēmus quae erunt agenda.

    But if you’re on the road, we’ll discuss what needs discussing in person, once you’ve caught up with me.Cic. Att. 3.5
